name: After § 54
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 54a. Calls on the Commission to elaborate diplomatic and technical solutions for the structured return of Afghans and to assist EU Member States in their talks with Taliban representatives; calls on the Commission, the EEAS and willing EU Member States to cooperate and to organise joint missions and flights to Afghanistan, pooling resources; calls on the EU’s Special Envoy to Afghanistan to convey that economic and trade cooperation, and the disbursement of any EU development aid, is conditional on the Taliban’s cooperation in the field of readmission of Afghans;
